titulo_es: A condition in a notice · Possibility and condition

texto: «Hvis» introduces a condition. In an open possibility the present is usually used; in an imaginary situation the preterito may appear with «ville» in the main. It takes care of the context, not just the verbal form.
Compare the two tracks and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

frases.da: Du får adgang, hvis du viser dit kort.
frases.es: Podrás entrar si muestras tu tarjeta.
frases.en: You can come in if you show your card.

frases.da: Hvis kortet er udløbet, skal du bestille et nyt.
frases.es: Si la tarjeta ha caducado, debes pedir una nueva.
frases.en: If the card has expired, you have to order a new one.
